text: There isn’t enough evidence to confirm whether this asset is deforestation-free. The analysis couldn’t check for tree-cover loss between 2021 and 2025 because key satellite data sources (like Hansen, JRC, or MGAP) didn’t cover this property. Without this data, we can’t rule out deforestation or confirm its absence. The evidence doesn’t support any claim—positive or negative—about deforestation or compliance (e.g., EUDR). Further investigation with better data is needed to assess this asset’s status.
